must: Use a warm-white and ink editorial palette with electric cyan as the only saturated accent.
Use Newsreader for display headings and Space Grotesk for interface text.
Keep dashboard layouts dense, asymmetric, and information-first with responsive mobile collapse.
avoid: Purple or violet as a brand accent.
Decorative gradients, background grids, or decorative glassmorphism.
Sparkle or emoji icons as generic AI decoration.
Centered blob-hero compositions and empty marketing mockups.

decisions.decision: Use Fathom-inspired calm workspace styling with neutral surfaces, dark navy structure, and cyan as the only primary accent; avoid purple.

Use a responsive, grid-free editorial landing page with a translucent glass header, starfield-only atmosphere, oversized type, cyan pill CTAs, and restrained orange/pink accents. Add tactile press feedback to all primary controls.
